prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit stretch of the Great Wall of China with worn brick paving, waist-high crenellated parapet, standard-height arched gate and stone steps, empty of tourists, evenly lit by soft overcast light, shadows very soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in soft overcast daylight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Lebanese woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, radiant glowing bridal makeup, dramatic long lashes, a soft rose lip, warm fair skin, icy platinum-blonde hair styled in low bun, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long copper chain ending in one large faceted amethyst drop, and on the other ear a large gold hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a lead small flared temple bell, a silver round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three rose-gold rings. LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily tall and powerful athletic woman, far beyond any real person; wide capped boulder-like shoulders, a broad flaring back and lats forming a dramatic V-taper, defined muscular arms, a firm chest, a deeply defined six-pack abdomen on a very narrow waist, round firm hips and strong muscular thighs with a visible quad sweep and defined calves; hard clean muscle under glowing skin, not bulky like a bodybuilder, not thin; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme cobalt-blue platform lace-up sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge.
